description.value:
This extension applies to the Medication, MedicationRequest, MedicationDispense and MedicationStatement resources and is used to represent the generic drug name of a medication. The medication generic drug name may not be the same as the subject medication (prescribed, dispensed or stated) but may be used to provide an additional or equivalent non-proprietary name. This extension is not to be the sole representation of the medication concept; it shall not be used as a substitute for medication code (e.g. Medication.code or MedicationStatement.medicationCodeableConcept).
If a system can only supply generic drug name information, and only in text form, that information will be supplied in the text portion of that code e.g. code.text or medicationCodeableConcept.text. This extension only supports the name portion of a medication concept as text, not a coded medication concept, and is unrelated to proprietary (brand) product information. It is available for use where a system needs to separate out the generic drug name string for handling or other processing.

definition.value: The medication generic drug name for an associated medication. This may not be the same as the subject medication (prescribed, dispensed or stated) but may be used to provide an additional or equivalent non-proprietary name.
